say:1:1260009001:0.text: Despite defeating all the fish monsters, they still writhe on the ground, with no sign of reverting to their original forms.

say:3:1260009002:1.source_cn: ……这些家伙，居然没有变成别的形态。

say:5:1260009003:1.text: Are they actually some breed of monster and not altered humans?
say:5:1260009003:1.source_cn: 难道说，它们本来就是鱼怪，而不是被变形的人类？

say:6:1260009004:1.text: While everyone is speculating, a hearty laugh breaks through the gloomy air.
say:6:1260009004:1.source_cn: 正在猜测的时候，一个破坏大家沉重气氛的爽朗笑声响了起来。

say:8:1260009005:1.text: Hahaha, thank you all for assisting me in dealing with these rebellious creatures!
say:8:1260009005:1.source_cn: 哈哈，血薇帮的各位！还有魔法师！谢谢你们帮我制服这些不...
say:8:1260009005:1.male: Hahaha, thank you all for assisting me in dealing with these rebellious creatures!
say:8:1260009005:1.female: Hahaha, thank you all for assisting me in dealing with these rebellious creatures!

say:9:1260009006:1.text: I'm Naso's mentor, but you can just call me "Eighty," as I once reeled in an 80-pound giant with a single rod, all by lonesome!
say:9:1260009006:1.source_cn: 我是南森的师父，你们叫我“八十斤”就好了，因为我当年曾...

say:10:1260009007:0.text: ...So he's abandoned his real name just to brag about a fish. These fanatics...
say:10:1260009007:0.source_cn: ……为了炫耀自己的鱼获，连本名都抛弃了啊，这帮钓鱼佬。

say:11:1260009008:0.text: Ha! The lackey of that "One-Rod" chump has arrived! I knew they'd want to challenge me!
say:11:1260009008:0.source_cn: 哈！“一零一杆”那小子的跟班来了！我就知道他们要跟我较劲！

say:12:1260009009:0.text: Sure enough, a young man rushes over from nearby.
say:12:1260009009:0.source_cn: 果然，不远处，一个小伙子也火急火燎地冲过来了。

say:15:1260009010:0.text: *Panting*... The Carmine Whispers, I can't believe I finally found you! I've been looking for ages...
say:15:1260009010:0.source_cn: 呼、呼！血薇帮的人，你们居然在这，我找了半天……

say:16:1260009011:1.text: Are you also an unofficial, non-registered member of the Fishing Society...?
say:16:1260009011:1.source_cn: 你也是钓鱼协会的……编外非记名成员？

say:17:1260009012:1.text: That's right, I'm Tobi, apprentice to "One-Rod," also known as the "Seahawk"! My dream is to one day surpass my master and reel in 200 catches in a single day!
say:17:1260009012:1.source_cn: 是，我是“一零一杆”师父的徒弟，名叫托比，外号鱼鹰！理...

say:18:1260009013:1.text: We fished all of last night, casting rod after rod non-stop!
say:18:1260009013:1.source_cn: 我们昨天晚上夜钓，一杆接着一杆，就没停过！

say:19:1260009014:1.text: And what we reeled in wasn't just some small fish; it was the coveted <style="highlight">damedangler</style>!
say:19:1260009014:1.source_cn: 而且钓上来的，可不是什么小鱼，而是所有钓鱼家梦寐以求的...

say:22:1260009015:0.text: Damedangler... Hmph, that's yesterday's news. My master and I caught something even rarer, a fish monster—
say:22:1260009015:0.source_cn: 冥湾美人……哼，那已经过时了，我跟师父钓的可是难得一见...

say:25:1260009016:1.source_cn: ——等等，要是没记错的话，冥湾美人，是那种嘴巴超级大，...

say:26:1260009017:1.female: One of those could gulp me and Chippy down in one bite, and even <style="stress"><player_name></style> might find them tough to handle...

say:27:1260009018:1.text: Yep, that's right! We reeled in a few of them, and they're pretty feisty. My master's still wrestling with them, but he won't get swallowed up just yet!

say:28:1260009019:1.text: Since I'm quick on my feet, I ran over here to ask for help!
say:28:1260009019:1.source_cn: 因为我腿脚快，所以我就跑过来求助了——

say:31:1260009020:0.text: You should have told us how dangerous this was from the start! We need to go help him right away!
say:31:1260009020:0.source_cn: 这种危险的事要一开始就说啊！！！我们得立刻去救人！

say:32:1260009021:1.text: It's fine! If my master knew we caught a fish better than "Eighty," he'd die happy, even if he got swallowed!
say:32:1260009021:1.source_cn: 没事的！如果我师父知道我们钓上的鱼赢过了“八十斤”，他...

say:33:1260009022:1.text: ...I've had enough of you fishing maniacs!
say:33:1260009022:1.source_cn: ……真是受不了你们这些钓鱼佬了！
